query: INSERT INTO store_blobs (sha512, size, relative_path, status, modified_at_ns, sources) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'ready', ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(sha512) DO UPDATE SET status = 'ready', modified_at_ns = excluded.modified_at_ns, last_used_at = unixepoch(), verified_at = unixepoch(), sources = CASE WHEN excluded.sources = '[]' THEN store_blobs.sources ELSE excluded.sources END
